facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 52°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

lines.label: Road
lines.text:
Effective June 10, SR 542/Road to Artist Point has reopened for the season. 
Reports have ended for this season. Traditionally weather and road conditions are reported from November 1 to April 1. Should adverse weather occur that will impact travel, updates will be provided as information is available

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 16 to 26 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Wells Creek
evidence.detail: left May 11; earlier seasons: June 3 (2023), June 9 (2024), June 6 (2025)

evidence.name: Marten Ridge
evidence.detail: left May 17; earlier seasons: June 12 (2023), June 8 (2024), June 10 (2025)

evidence.name: MF Nooksack
evidence.detail: left June 7; earlier seasons: June 16 (2023), July 3 (2024), June 23 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at all 3 nearby stations.

evidence.name: Wells Creek
evidence.detail: 17.5 in on April 4; earlier seasons: 37.5 in (2023), 24.0 in (2024), 32.5 in (2025)

evidence.name: Marten Ridge
evidence.detail: 23.2 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 59.8 in (2023), 32.0 in (2024), 46.2 in (2025)

evidence.name: MF Nooksack
evidence.detail: 33.1 in on April 18; earlier seasons: 65.0 in (2023), 46.0 in (2024), 49.4 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 13 and July 8, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Wells Creek
evidence.detail: melted out May 11, 1,271 ft below the pass; points to May 2 to July 3

evidence.name: Marten Ridge
evidence.detail: melted out May 17, 1,791 ft below the pass; points to May 13 to July 22

evidence.name: MF Nooksack
evidence.detail: melted out June 7, 371 ft below the pass; points to May 20 to July 8
